hint: The CAC filing regime for recommendation algorithms and generative services. Critically NOT licensing — filing is notification, not permission. English coverage routinely mistranslates it as 'registration' or 'approval'.
A specific mandatory regulatory procedure under 网信办 rules, not the generic English phrase. Triggered by 舆论属性或者社会动员能力.
GB/T 22239 / 25070. Five levels, 三级 is the common bar for serious systems. Now being applied to model weights. Not comparable to ASL or RAND SL — document why.
A pervasive PRC regulatory design principle: sort things into kinds, then into severity tiers. Appears in data law, AI law, security law. English has no single term.

zh_headword: 舆论属性或社会动员能力
en: public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capability
hint: The legal trigger phrase that pulls a service into the 安全评估 regime. Untranslatable as a unit; carries the whole logic of PRC content regulation.
《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》 2022. Broader than 'deepfake' — covers all synthetic media generation. Predates and partly subsumes generative AI rules.
Identity verification regime. Adjacent to KYC but a different legal object — check how it interacts with AI service access.
The duty placed on a service provider as the responsible entity. Structurally important in every PRC AI rule; English 'accountability' is weaker and vaguer.
Governs data leaving China. Increasingly relevant to model training data and API traffic.
《科技伦理审查办法（试行）》 2023. Institutional ethics review with a listed-activities annex. Closest English analogue is an IRB, but the scope is far wider.
Adopted from WEF vocabulary but has taken on specific PRC meaning — iterative, tolerant-then-tightening regulation. Check 《新一代人工智能治理原则》 and 全球人工智能治理倡议.
The dominant operational meaning of 'AI safety' in Chinese industry practice. If a Chinese company says it does 安全, this is usually what it means — a crucial disambiguation for foreign readers.
A named component of 总体国家安全观 that AI content rules serve. Report factually and neutrally; it explains regulatory priorities that otherwise look arbitrary to English readers.

zh_headword: 生成式人工智能服务备案
hint: The operative filing track for LLM services. CAICT publishes running counts. Distinguish carefully from 大模型备案, which is informal shorthand.
Imported term; check whether PRC AI usage differs from the fintech origin and whether any AI sandbox actually operates.

HIGH VALUE. Means indigenous/self-reliant AND controllable-by-us. The 自主 is about national supply-chain independence, NOT about AI autonomy — a catastrophic false friend for anyone reading PRC AI documents in translation.

HIGH VALUE. The standard PRC formulation for what AI should be. English readers hear 'controllable' as the alignment property; the PRC sense is closer to 'not dependent on foreign tech and not socially disruptive'. Document the gap precisely.

The master frame for how PRC policy trades off innovation against risk. Appears in nearly every AI policy document. English 'balancing innovation and safety' is close but loses the 统筹 (unified planning) sense.
The doctrinal umbrella since 2014 covering 16+ security domains. Explains why AI safety in PRC discourse sits under national security rather than beside it.

Literally 'stranglehold on the neck'. Technologies where foreign dependence creates vulnerability — chips above all. Vivid, informal, and ubiquitous in policy text, which English 'chokepoint' understates.
State mobilisation of resources for strategic technology goals. Directly relevant to compute buildout and any analysis of PRC AI scaling capacity.
2023-onward economic framing placing AI at the centre of growth policy. Marxist-political-economy register; English translations are uniformly awkward.
State initiative for AI diffusion across sectors, modelled on 互联网+. Signals a diffusion-first rather than frontier-first strategy — analytically important.
National compute infrastructure programme siting datacentres in western provinces. Concrete and load-bearing for compute-governance analysis.
Planning against worst-case outcomes. The nearest native PRC analogue to risk-management framing in AI safety — potentially a bridge term worth flagging as such.
From 《全球人工智能治理倡议》. 向善 (toward the good) is stronger and more moral than English 'for good'.
Standard opening formulation in PRC AI ethics documents. Check whether it does the work 'human-centred AI' does in English or is purely formulaic.
Leapfrogging a competitor by taking a different technological path. Common in AI commentary; note whether it has fallen out of official favour.

en: open competition to select the best
hint: Competitive tendering for state R&D tasks. Relevant to how PRC AI research funding is allocated.
Domestic substitution of the IT stack. Contraction of 信息技术应用创新. Almost never explained in English coverage.
The overarching innovation-policy goal. Distinguish from 自主可控, which is the property; this is the programme.

HIGH VALUE. The Chinese umbrella term covering LLMs, multimodal and foundation models. Has no clean English equivalent — 'large model' is not idiomatic English, yet 大模型 is the single most common word in Chinese AI discourse. Document what it includes and excludes.
HIGH VALUE. Richer and more policy-central than English 'compute' — it is an infrastructure and industrial-policy noun (算力网络, 算力中心, 智算中心). English 'compute' is a recent back-formation by comparison.
How PRC institutions (上海AI实验室) file the scheming/deceptive-alignment cluster. An English-language reader searching for 'scheming' will never find this literature.
The two-tier threshold system in 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架》 — an alternative to numbered capability levels (ASL/preparedness tiers). A genuine PRC contribution to frontier safety design.
AI-specific datacentre, distinct from 数据中心. Load-bearing for reading PRC compute buildout reporting.
The PRC policy register's version of alignment. Narrower than English 'alignment' — about social/ethical values, not about goal-directedness or control. Cross-link to the ai-alignment entry.
Check which sense dominates: state controllability, developer controllability, or the technical alignment property. Likely all three, undifferentiated — which is itself the finding.
Robotics + foundation models. Far more prominent as an organising category in Chinese discourse than 'embodied AI' is in English.
Distinguished from 通用人工智能 (AGI) by the single character 型. Verify this distinction is real and observed, and note who observes it.

HIGH VALUE. The PRC taxonomy category under which 失控 (loss of control) is filed — framing it as an engineering fault rather than an agent problem. A structural divergence from the English literature, not a wording difference.
Security properties built into a system's architecture rather than bolted on. A Chinese cybersecurity concept (邬江兴) now applied to AI. Check whether it maps onto anything in AI safety.
The dominant PRC academic/industry framing before 'AI safety' arrived. CAICT has a whole programme. Note how it relates to and competes with 人工智能安全.
Common compound in Chinese lab writing. Check whether it means harmlessness training specifically rather than alignment generally.
A named national strategic direction in 新一代人工智能发展规划, broader than the English swarm-robotics sense. Check current usage for multi-agent systems.
